resources.name: Agentic SDLC URL Shortener
resources.description: E2E lifecycle collection for the URL Shortener API. PREREQUISITE: the application must already be running locally at the Base Environment's base_url (default http://localhost:8080) before running these requests - start it with: docker-compose up -d (from the repo root), then DB_PORT=5435 ./mvnw spring-boot:run (from project/). DB_PORT=5435 is required because local Postgres is published on host port 5435, not the default 5432. See docs/00-Executive-Summary.md for the full architectural knowledge graph.

resources.name: URL Shortener E2E Lifecycle
resources.description: Full create -> redirect -> metadata -> delete flow. Run this folder top to bottom (Insomnia: right-click folder -> 'Run'). Request 1 extracts shortCode into the environment; requests 2-4 consume it. Request 4 deletes the URL it created, so running the whole folder leaves the database clean.

resources.name: 1. Create Short URL
resources.description: POST /api/v1/urls - creates a short URL and extracts the generated shortCode into the environment for the rest of the folder to use.

resources.name: 2. Follow Redirect
resources.description: GET /{shortCode} - expects 302 Found with a Location header pointing at the original longUrl. Redirect-following is turned off for this request so the 302 itself is visible/assertable rather than silently followed.

resources.name: 3. Get Metadata
resources.description: GET /api/v1/urls/{shortCode} - returns the stored metadata (longUrl, createdAt, expiresAt, status) for the short code created in request 1. Click analytics live on a separate /stats endpoint, not covered by this request.

resources.name: 4. Delete (Cleanup)
resources.description: DELETE /api/v1/urls/{shortCode} - removes the short URL created in request 1, so running this folder end to end leaves no test data behind. Expect 204 No Content.
